description: Land Acquisition - Delgahakanda, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (15 lots) with descriptions of each property, including land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land acquisitions for public purposes. There is no government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized category content present.
